errors.text_span: The y-axis, labeled “count,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 85, with tick mark intervals of 10.
errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis does not match either plot. Plot (a) has a y-axis from 0 to 100 with intervals of 20. Plot (b) has a y-axis from 0 to 175 with intervals of 25.

errors.text_span: The blue line in (a) representing “Llama3 FFN value neurons” begins at a value of approximately 10 and increases linearly to a peak value of approximately 75 around layer 25, remaining relatively constant at around 70 until layer 35, where the value decreases to approximately 50.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend in plot (a) is almost entirely incorrect. The line begins near 0, not 10. The trend is not linear but has several sharp spikes. The peak is not at layer 25 (where the value is ~20), but rather at layer 28 with a value of ~95. The data does not extend to layer 35; it ends at layer 30.

errors.text_span: The blue line in (b) representing “Llama3 FFN neuron scores” starts at a value of approximately 5 and increases to a peak value of approximately 30 around layer 20, then declines to a value of approximately 15 at layer 35.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend in plot (b) is almost entirely incorrect. The line is green, not blue. The legend label is "Llama3 FFN value neurons", not "Llama3 FFN neuron scores". The trend does not peak at layer 20; it remains very low until layer 27 and then increases dramatically to a peak of approximately 160 at layer 30. It does not decline, and the data does not extend to layer 35.
